plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Manufacturing Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. The program details state the student 'will be awarded an Industrial Technology: Manufacturing Technology Associate of Science degree'. This plan transcribes the program's only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Manufacturing Technology / Associate of Science / 62-68 units / 4 terms / to Degree', in full. In 2025-2026 the same pathway was listed at 62-68 units in 6 terms. The mapper also lists a separate Manufacturing Technology Certificate of Achievement program, a different credential, which was not transcribed. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 62-68 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 17-19.5 / 16-17 / 14-15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Major List A' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Major List B' (2-3) and '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5); Term 3 'Major List B' (2-3); Term 4 'Major List B' (2-3). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 62 units. The Term 1 'Major List A' slot is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded with category 'major'. The 'Major List B' slot is printed in Terms 2, 3 and 4 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. MFGT B55 (Term 4) shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so none are recorded, and the flag is disclosed on that row. No other row shows a flag. General-education and major-list slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
